docs.summary: Builds a ragdoll onto a humanoid's bones: a rigidbody and collider per body part, and constraints joining each part to the one above it with limits a human joint has. A Ragdoll graph node uses it to make the bodies it drives, and it works just as well on any imported humanoid from script.
